drills.name: Form Shooting Progression
drills.description: One-hand form shots from three feet, adding the guide hand at five clean makes, then stepping back one pace per five makes out to the elbow.
drills.coachingPoints: Balance, eyes, elbow under the ball, hold the follow-through.

drills.name: Catch-and-Shoot Spots
drills.description: Passer under the rim feeds shooters rotating through five perimeter spots. Shooter shows hands ready, catches on the hop, and shoots in rhythm. Five makes per spot.
drills.coachingPoints: Feet set and hands up before the pass arrives. Catch already loaded.

drills.name: One-Dribble Pull-Ups
drills.description: From the wing, attack a cone with one hard dribble either direction and rise into a pull-up jumper. Five makes going left, five going right, rotate lines.
drills.coachingPoints: One hard dribble to your spot, then straight up. Don't drift.

drills.name: Free Throw Pressure Pairs
drills.description: Partners alternate free throws in a race to ten makes; a miss subtracts one. Between turns the waiting partner does defensive slides to keep legs game-tired.
drills.coachingPoints: Same routine every time. Breathe, dip, and finish high.

drills.name: Two-Ball Stationary Handling
drills.description: Every player with two balls: pound dribbles together, alternating, high-low, then one-ball crossovers with the weak hand doing double reps. Thirty seconds per pattern.
drills.coachingPoints: Pound it hard and keep your eyes off the ball the whole time.

drills.name: Cone Change-of-Direction Series
drills.description: Dribble a line of four cones executing a called move at each: crossover, between the legs, behind the back. Finish with a layup, then return with the weak hand leading.
drills.coachingPoints: Change speed with the change of direction. The move is the setup, the burst is the escape.

drills.name: Full-Court 1v1 Pressure Dribble
drills.description: Ball handler advances the ball full court against a defender applying live pressure. No help, no time limit. Cross half court under control, then swap roles coming back.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay low, protect with your body, and change pace to break the pressure.

drills.name: Partner Pass Series
drills.description: Pairs 12 feet apart cycle chest passes, bounce passes, and one-hand off-the-move passes, 15 each, stepping into every throw. Finish with a rapid-fire 30-second round.
drills.coachingPoints: Step to your target and snap it. Thumbs down on the follow-through.

drills.name: Three-Man Weave
drills.description: Three lines run the full-court weave: pass and cut behind two, finishing with a layup, then weave back the other way. Add a make-it-or-repeat rule once it's clean.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass ahead of the runner and sprint behind two. Hit them in stride.

drills.name: Entry Pass vs Denial
drills.description: Wing works to get open against a live denying defender; passer at the top must deliver a clean entry with a pass fake first. Three completions, rotate all three spots.
drills.coachingPoints: Fake a pass to make a pass. Hit the hand away from the defender.

drills.name: Drive-and-Kick Reads
drills.description: Driver attacks the paint off the dribble while two teammates space to the corner and wing; a coach-controlled helper takes away one option and the driver kicks to the open man for a shot.
drills.coachingPoints: Drive with your eyes up. The help defender tells you who's open.

drills.name: Zig-Zag Defensive Slides
drills.description: Defenders slide a zig-zag pattern up the court between cones, chopping feet and swinging through at each cone, then sprint back on the whistle.
drills.coachingPoints: Nose behind the ball line, low hips, push off the back foot. Never cross your feet.

drills.name: Shell Drill 4v4
drills.description: Four offensive players pass around the perimeter while four defenders jump to ball-you-man positions on every pass. Progress from no drives to live drives with help.
drills.coachingPoints: Move on the pass, not the catch. See your man and the ball on every swing.

drills.name: Closeout Reps
drills.description: Defender starts in the paint, sprints at a shooter receiving a pass on the wing, and breaks down into a high-hand closeout, then contains one live dribble.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint two-thirds, chop the last third. High hand to the shot, don't fly by.

drills.name: Screen Navigation 2v2
drills.description: Offense runs live ball screens and off-ball screens; on-ball defender works over or under on the coach's call while the screener's defender hedges or drops and both talk it through.
drills.coachingPoints: Call the screen early. Yell it before it hits, then fight over the top.

drills.name: Box Out Battles
drills.description: Coach shoots; the defender makes contact, boxes out, and pursues the rebound while the partner fights to get around. Ball live until someone secures it. Winner stays on offense.
drills.coachingPoints: Hit first. Find your man, make contact, then go get the ball.

drills.name: Backboard Put-Backs
drills.description: Player tosses the ball off the backboard to themselves, rebounds at the peak, and scores immediately without bringing the ball down. Five makes each side of the rim.
drills.coachingPoints: Catch it high and go right back up. The ball never comes below your chin.

drills.name: Long Rebound Chase and Outlet
drills.description: Coach fires shots that miss long; two players read the carom, chase it down, and the winner pivots and hits an outlet target sprinting the wing.
drills.coachingPoints: Long shot, long rebound. Anticipate the carom and go get it at full speed.

drills.name: Five-Out Ball Movement
drills.description: Five players in five-out spacing move the ball with a two-second limit per catch: pass and cut, fill the open spot, no dribbling. Coach calls shot to end each possession.
drills.coachingPoints: Catch, see the rim, move it. The ball finds the open man faster than the dribble.

drills.name: Continuous 3v2 to 2v1
drills.description: Three attack two defenders down the floor; on the make or stop, the two defenders outlet and attack the other way against one retreating attacker. Runs continuously.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint wide lanes and make the defense commit before you pass.

drills.name: Mikan Drill
drills.description: Player stands under the rim and alternates right-hand and left-hand layups off the glass without letting the ball touch the floor. Sixty seconds, counting makes.
drills.coachingPoints: Inside foot up, ball off the square. Land ready to go the other way.

drills.name: Reverse Mikan Turns
drills.description: Same continuous rhythm as the Mikan drill but finishing on the far side of the rim each time, using the backboard to shield the shot. Sixty seconds, then switch which shoulder leads.
drills.coachingPoints: Put the rim between you and the help. Finish high off the glass, don't lay it in soft.

drills.name: Off-Hand Finish Ladder
drills.description: Three finishes from each side using only the outside hand: standard layup, inside-hand reverse, and a short floater. Five makes at each spot before moving.
drills.coachingPoints: Outside hand, outside foot. If the shot needs your strong hand, you took the wrong angle.

drills.name: Euro-Step Through the Cone
drills.description: Player attacks a cone placed in the lane, takes the first step to one side and the second step across to the other, then finishes. Six each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Long first step, longer second. Pick the ball up before the first step, not during.

drills.name: Floater Range Finder
drills.description: From the elbow and both short corners, the player takes one dribble toward the lane and shoots a one-foot floater over an imaginary contest. Five makes from each of the four spots.
drills.coachingPoints: Shoot it off one foot going up, not two feet drifting. High arc, soft off the fingers.

drills.name: One-Hand Form Sequence
drills.description: Starting three feet from the rim, the shooter takes ten one-handed shots with the guide hand behind the back, then adds the guide hand and steps back to the block. Twenty shots total.
drills.coachingPoints: Elbow under the ball, wrist snaps down. If it spins sideways, your hand is off center.

drills.name: Wall Alignment Shooting
drills.description: Shooter stands three feet from a wall and shoots straight up so the ball comes back to the same spot. Twenty reps checking that the ball never drifts left or right.
drills.coachingPoints: Ball comes back to you or your elbow is flying out. Same finish every single rep.

drills.name: Elbow-to-Elbow Form Shots
drills.description: Shooter makes a shot at one elbow, sprints to touch the opposite elbow, and shoots again on the catch from a partner. Ten makes total.
drills.coachingPoints: Feet set before the ball arrives. Same release tired as fresh.

drills.name: Five-Spot Catch and Shoot
drills.description: Passer feeds the shooter at five spots around the arc. Shooter must make two in a row at each spot before moving on, then the pair switches.
drills.coachingPoints: Hands ready before the pass arrives. Hop into it and land where you shot from.

drills.name: Curl Off the Screen Shots
drills.description: Shooter runs off a cone set as a screen, curls into the catch, and shoots. Ten reps each side, with the passer delivering the ball to the shooting pocket.
drills.coachingPoints: Shoulder past the screen before you turn. Catch it already squared to the rim.

drills.name: Relocate and Shoot
drills.description: Shooter takes a catch-and-shoot, then immediately relocates one spot along the arc for a second pass and shot. Six pairs of shots, alternating direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Move the second the ball leaves your hands. Get to the spot early, then set your feet.

drills.name: Step-Back Off the Bounce
drills.description: Player attacks a cone, plants, and pushes back into a one-dribble step-back jumper. Five makes going right, five going left.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell the drive before you go back. Land balanced, don't fade sideways.

drills.name: Two-Dribble Attack Series
drills.description: From the wing the player takes exactly two hard dribbles and rises into a pull-up from the elbow. Six each direction, then six starting with a jab step.
drills.coachingPoints: Get low on the first dribble, high on the shot. Gather on two, not three.

drills.name: Free Throw Routine Reps
drills.description: Every player builds the same pre-shot routine and repeats it for two sets of ten, saying the routine out loud on the first five. Track makes each round.
drills.coachingPoints: Same routine, same breath, every time. The routine is the shot.

drills.name: Free Throws on Tired Legs
drills.description: Player runs a full-court sprint and back, then steps to the line for two free throws. Repeat four times and keep a running total for the team.
drills.coachingPoints: Slow your breathing before the routine, not during it. Legs tired means push a little more, not aim harder.

drills.name: Pound Dribble Series
drills.description: Stationary hard dribbles at three heights: waist, knee, and ankle. Thirty seconds each hand at each height with the off hand up as a shield.
drills.coachingPoints: Pound it, don't pat it. Eyes up the whole time, feel the floor come back.

drills.name: Figure-Eight Ball Control
drills.description: Players weave the ball through and around the legs in a figure eight, first walking the ball around with no dribble, then with one dribble per pass-through. Forty-five seconds each way.
drills.coachingPoints: Fingertips, not palms. Wide base, chest up.

drills.name: Dribble Tag
drills.description: Every player dribbles inside the three-point arc while two taggers try to knock balls away without fouling. Anyone who loses the ball or steps out joins the taggers.
drills.coachingPoints: Head up or you are the next one out. Keep the ball on the far hip from trouble.

drills.name: Crossover, Between, Behind Series
drills.description: Down and back the length of the floor doing one move at each of five cones: crossover, between the legs, behind the back, then repeat the set going the other way.
drills.coachingPoints: Change speed with the move, not after it. Low and quick through the switch.

drills.name: Retreat and Attack Dribble
drills.description: Player dribbles hard at a cone, takes two retreat dribbles backward, then attacks past it with a crossover. Six reps each hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Retreat with your chest facing the pressure. Push off the back foot to go, don't drift.

drills.name: Hesitation and Go
drills.description: Player attacks a cone at speed, rises up slightly as if to shoot, then explodes past on the same hand. Six each direction, then six finishing with a pass to a partner.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell it with your eyes and shoulders, not just the ball. Go on the half beat he relaxes.

drills.name: Weak-Hand Only Full Court
drills.description: Players go the length of the floor using only the off hand, finishing with an off-hand layup. Four trips, and any strong-hand dribble sends them back to start.
drills.coachingPoints: Ugly is fine, sloppy is not. Protect it with the body since the hand isn't ready yet.

drills.name: Off-Hand 1v1 Half Court
drills.description: Live one-on-one from the wing where the offensive player may only dribble with the off hand. Defense plays honest. First to three baskets, then switch roles.
drills.coachingPoints: Take the angle your weak hand can actually finish. Use your body as the shield.

drills.name: Two-Ball Alternating Pounds
drills.description: Player dribbles two balls at once, alternating so one is up while the other is down, then switches to pounding both together. Forty-five seconds each pattern.
drills.coachingPoints: Rhythm first, speed second. When it falls apart, slow down and rebuild it.

drills.name: Trap Escape Reps
drills.description: Ball handler picks up the dribble in the corner while two defenders trap. He has three seconds to pivot out and make a live pass to an outlet. Six reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Chin the ball and pivot, don't panic-dribble into the trap. Find the man behind the trap.

drills.name: Ten-Second Pressure Advance
drills.description: Offense must get the ball past half court against full-court denial pressure inside ten seconds. Run it six times with the defense rotating fresh each rep.
drills.coachingPoints: Get it in and go, don't let him load up on the inbound. Dribble to a pass, not to a dead end.

drills.name: Two-Ball Partner Passing
drills.description: Partners stand twelve feet apart with two balls, one throwing a chest pass while the other throws a bounce pass at the same time. Thirty seconds, then swap which side bounces.
drills.coachingPoints: Step into it and follow through thumbs down. Catch with your eyes, throw with your feet.

drills.name: Bounce Pass Through the Gap
drills.description: Two cones set four feet apart act as a defender's legs. Passers hit a partner with a bounce pass through the gap from fifteen feet, ten reps each hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Land it two-thirds of the way there. One hand off the dribble is faster than two.

drills.name: Star Passing
drills.description: Five players at five spots pass in a star pattern and follow their pass to the next spot. Add a second ball once the first pattern is clean.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass and go, don't pass and watch. Call his name before you throw it.

drills.name: Keep Away 3v1
drills.description: Three players pass inside a fifteen foot square while one defender tries to deflect. Ten consecutive completions wins, and any deflection swaps the defender.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass fake the first look, then throw the second. Move to a new angle after every pass.

drills.name: Skip Pass Across the Floor
drills.description: Ball starts on one wing with a closeout defender flying at the passer. Passer skips it to the opposite wing for a shot. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Throw it over the top with a one-hand push, not a lob. Hit him in the shooting pocket.

drills.name: Head-Up Numbers Passing
drills.description: While partners pass back and forth at speed, a coach standing behind each receiver holds up fingers that the passer has to call out before releasing the ball. Sixty seconds per turn.
drills.coachingPoints: See the floor past the ball. If you have to look at the pass, it's too slow.

drills.name: Drive and Dish Live
drills.description: Ball handler attacks from the wing against one defender with two teammates spotted up. He must finish or deliver a pass off the live dribble. Six reps each, then rotate.
drills.coachingPoints: Pass out of the gather, not after you pick it up. Two feet in the paint before you decide.

drills.name: One-Hand Push Pass Reps
drills.description: Player drives past a cone and delivers a one-hand push pass to a partner on the wing without picking up the dribble. Eight each hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Same hand you dribble with, no gather. Push it, don't fling it.

drills.name: Wrap-Around Baseline Feed
drills.description: Driver gets to the baseline and wraps a one-hand pass around the defender to a teammate on the weak-side block. Six reps from each corner.
drills.coachingPoints: Get your shoulder past him first. Wrap it low, the help is always high.

drills.name: Post Entry Angles
drills.description: Wing player has to create a passing angle to a post partner who is being fronted, using a dribble to the corner or a reversal to the top. Six reps each angle.
drills.coachingPoints: Change the angle with a dribble before you throw. Bounce it when he's fronted, never over the top.

drills.name: Pass Fake to Entry
drills.description: Passer holds the ball on the wing with a defender in the passing lane. He must use a fake high and deliver low, or fake low and deliver high, to reach a cutter. Ten reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Fake a pass to make a pass. Move the defender's hands before you throw.

drills.name: Outlet and Push Ahead
drills.description: Rebounder secures a missed shot, turns to the sideline, and hits a guard sprinting the outlet. The guard then pushes it ahead to a wide runner. Ten reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Chin the rebound, pivot to the outside. Throw it ahead of him, not at him.

drills.name: Stance and Slide Mirror
drills.description: Partners face each other in a defensive stance and one mirrors the other's lateral slides and short retreats for thirty seconds. Three rounds each.
drills.coachingPoints: Push off the trail foot, never click the heels. Hands active, chest up.

drills.name: Wing 1v1 Contain
drills.description: Live one-on-one from the wing where the defender scores a point for forcing a baseline pickup or a contested jumper, not just for a stop. Best of six, then switch.
drills.coachingPoints: Beat him to the spot, then take the charge line away. Contest with the high hand, don't reach.

drills.name: Deny the Wing
drills.description: Defender plays ball-you-man denial on a wing who is trying to get open for one pass. Thirty seconds live, then swap. Offense scores only by catching it above the free throw line extended.
drills.coachingPoints: Hand in the lane, thumb down. See the ball and your man with one turn of the head.

drills.name: Help and Recover 2v2
drills.description: Two offensive players on one side, two defenders. Ball handler drives, the help defender steps in to stop the ball, then recovers to his own man on the kick-out. Six reps each pair.
drills.coachingPoints: Help early, recover on the flight of the ball. Sprint back, don't drift back.

drills.name: Low Man Rotation
drills.description: Ball is driven baseline and the weak-side low defender has to rotate over to take the charge spot while the top defender drops to his man. Eight reps from each corner.
drills.coachingPoints: Low man is always the first helper. Beat him to the block and get your feet set early.

drills.name: Scramble 4v4 Rotation
drills.description: Coach throws a ball to any offensive player and the defense has to find their matchups on the fly while the offense attacks immediately. Play it out, then reset with a new random pass.
drills.coachingPoints: Talk first, match second. Somebody has the ball, somebody has the rim, everybody else points.

drills.name: Long Closeout Short Closeout
drills.description: Defender starts in the paint, sprints at a shooter in the corner with choppy steps and a high hand, then repeats to a shooter at the top. Six pairs of closeouts.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint the first two-thirds, chop the last third. High hand on a shooter, low hands on a driver.

drills.name: Closeout to Live 1v1
drills.description: Defender closes out on a catch and the possession goes live from there. Offense has two dribbles only, so the defender is rewarded for a controlled closeout. Six reps each.
drills.coachingPoints: Don't fly by. A contested two beats a wide open drive every time.

drills.name: Over, Under, Switch Calls
drills.description: Two defenders work a ball screen three ways on the coach's call: go over the top, slip under it, or switch. Six reps of each call with the offense running the same screen.
drills.coachingPoints: The screener's defender makes the call and makes it loud. Over on a shooter, under on a driver.

drills.name: Chase Through the Off-Ball Screen
drills.description: Shooter runs off a down screen while his defender has to fight over the top and contest the catch-and-shoot. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Get skinny and beat him to the catch, don't trail him to it. Bump the cutter legally on the way through.

drills.name: Hedge and Get Back
drills.description: Screener's defender shows hard at the ball handler for one beat, then retreats to his own man before the roll gets deep. Eight reps, alternating sides of the floor.
drills.coachingPoints: Show your chest, then get out. One beat of hedge is enough, two and you're beat on the roll.

drills.name: Hit, Find, Get
drills.description: Coach shoots, and on the release every defender makes contact with his man, finds the ball, and goes to get it. Run it eight times with the offense trying to get around the box out.
drills.coachingPoints: Hit him first, then look for the ball. Contact before the ball comes off the rim, not after.

drills.name: Three-Man Rebound War
drills.description: Three players inside the lane compete for a shot the coach intentionally misses. Whoever secures it must score before the other two can stop him. First to three.
drills.coachingPoints: Chin it and keep it high. Two hands on the ball until you go back up.

drills.name: Box Out the Cutter
drills.description: Offensive player starts on the perimeter and cuts on the shot while the defender has to find him and seal before the ball comes off. Six reps each, alternating who shoots.
drills.coachingPoints: Don't ball watch. Feel for him with a forearm, then widen your base.

drills.name: Shot Side Positioning Reps
drills.description: Coach shoots from five different spots and players practice sliding to the opposite side of the rim, since most misses come off long and away from the shooter. Two reps per spot.
drills.coachingPoints: Most misses come out on the weak side. Move on the shot, not on the miss.

drills.name: Seal and Hold the Block
drills.description: Post player seals a defender behind him on the block and holds the position for a three count while a coach lobs a rebound to that spot. Six reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: Wide base, arms out and legal. Own the space before the shot goes up.

drills.name: Tip Drill to Finish
drills.description: Player tosses the ball off the backboard and tips it back up twice with one hand before finishing on the third. Six reps each hand.
drills.coachingPoints: Keep it above your head, never bring it down into traffic. Fingertips, not a slap.

drills.name: Put-Back Through Contact
drills.description: Rebounder secures a miss with a partner leaning on him and has to go straight back up without dribbling. Eight reps, then switch who plays the contact.
drills.coachingPoints: Land, then go. Straight up strong, don't fade away from the contact.

drills.name: Long Rebound Guard Crash
drills.description: Coach shoots deep threes that come off long. Guards start at the arc and have to read the flight and beat the bigs to the long carom. Ten shots.
drills.coachingPoints: Long shot, long rebound. Guards step in on the flight, don't leak out early.

drills.name: Rebound and Go
drills.description: Defensive rebounder secures the board and immediately pushes the ball up the floor himself against one retreating defender. Eight reps, alternating rebounders.
drills.coachingPoints: Two dribbles before you look up. Rebound with your feet already turned upcourt.

drills.name: Free Throw Line Box Outs
drills.description: Full five-man box out off a free throw with the offense crashing live. Defense has to secure it cleanly three times in a row before the drill ends.
drills.coachingPoints: Shooters' side steps in first. Nobody leaves the paint until the ball is in two hands.

drills.name: Seventeens Sideline Sprints
drills.description: Players run sideline to sideline seventeen times inside a set time, sized to the age group. Two rounds with a full three minutes of rest between.
drills.coachingPoints: Touch the line with your hand every time. Pace the first eight, empty it on the last four.

drills.name: Baseline Suicide Ladder
drills.description: Sprint to the near free throw line and back, half court and back, far free throw line and back, full court and back. Four reps with sixty seconds rest.
drills.coachingPoints: Drop your hips at every line, don't stand up to turn. Same effort on rep four as rep one.

drills.name: Transition Sprint Pairs
drills.description: Two players sprint the floor together finishing with a layup, jog back, and go again. Eight trips per pair at game speed.
drills.coachingPoints: Wide lanes, full speed. The pass has to lead him, not slow him down.

drills.name: Lane Agility Box
drills.description: Player sprints the length of the lane, slides across the baseline, backpedals up the far side, and slides back to start. Four reps each direction.
drills.coachingPoints: Never cross your feet on the slide. Chest stays over your knees through every corner.

drills.name: Four-Cone Reaction Shuffle
drills.description: Four cones in a square and the player starts in the middle. Coach points to a cone and the player slides or sprints there and back. Thirty seconds on, thirty off, four rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: React off his hand, not his eyes. Get back through the middle every time.

drills.name: Jump Rope Intervals
drills.description: Thirty seconds of two-foot jumps, thirty of alternating feet, thirty of single leg each side, with fifteen seconds rest between. Two rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay on the balls of the feet, quiet landings. Wrists turn the rope, not the arms.

drills.name: Bodyweight Lower Body Circuit
drills.description: Four stations at forty seconds each: bodyweight squats, reverse lunges, calf raises, and wall sits. Two rounds with a minute between.
drills.coachingPoints: Knees track over the toes, never inward. Quality reps until the clock stops.

drills.name: Core and Hip Series
drills.description: Front plank, side planks, dead bugs, and glute bridges for thirty seconds each with fifteen seconds between. Two full rounds.
drills.coachingPoints: Ribs down, belt tight. If your hips sag, stop the clock and reset.

drills.name: Push and Pull Strength Pairs
drills.description: Partners alternate push-ups, inverted rows on a sturdy rail, and partner-resisted holds for forty seconds each. Two rounds through.
drills.coachingPoints: Full range or stop the set. Body in one line from ear to ankle.

drills.name: Continuous 5v5 No Whistle
drills.description: Live five-on-five where the ball never stops, with makes taken out immediately and misses pushed the other way. Four-minute blocks with ninety seconds between.
drills.coachingPoints: Sprint the floor both ways. Talk more when you are tired, not less.

drills.name: Pick-and-Roll Two-Man Game
drills.description: Ball handler and screener run a side ball screen against two defenders, reading whether to turn the corner, hit the roll, or pop. Six reps each pairing before rotating.
drills.coachingPoints: Set your man up before you use the screen. Screener rolls to the rim, not to the sideline.

drills.name: Down Screen and Curl Reads
drills.description: Screener sets a down screen for a cutter who reads the defender: curl if trailed, straight cut if the defender goes under, and flare if he cheats over the top. Eight reps each side.
drills.coachingPoints: The cutter reads the defense, the screener reads the cutter. Wait for the screen, don't run past it.

drills.name: Back Cut the Overplay
drills.description: Wing gets denied hard, takes one step toward the ball, then back cuts to the rim for a bounce pass. Six reps each side with the defender playing honest denial.
drills.coachingPoints: Sell it toward the ball first. When his hand is in the lane, go behind him.

drills.name: Pass and Cut Keep the Floor
drills.description: Four players on the perimeter pass and every passer must cut through the lane, with the next player filling the empty spot. Two minutes continuous, no dribbles allowed.
drills.coachingPoints: Cut hard through, don't drift through. Somebody fills behind you every single time.

drills.name: Spacing Cones Five-Out
drills.description: Cones mark five spots fifteen to eighteen feet apart. Offense moves the ball with the rule that no two players may stand inside the same cone's zone. Two minutes, then remove the cones and hold the spacing.
drills.coachingPoints: Stay an arm's length wider than feels natural. Crowding your teammate brings his defender to the ball.

drills.name: Drive, Draw Two, Kick
drills.description: Live four-on-four where a basket only counts if the possession includes a paint touch followed by a kick-out pass. Play to four scores.
drills.coachingPoints: Get two defenders to look at you before you pass. Space away from the drive, not toward it.

drills.name: Four Passes Before a Shot
drills.description: Live half-court five-on-five with a rule that the offense must complete four passes before shooting, unless it is a layup. Play to six baskets.
drills.coachingPoints: Don't hold it. Catch, look inside, then move it before the defense resets.

drills.name: Side-to-Side Ball Reversal
drills.description: Five offensive players must swing the ball from one side of the floor to the other twice before attacking a live four-defender shell. Run eight possessions.
drills.coachingPoints: Reverse it before the help is set. Every catch faces the rim for a beat.

drills.name: Five-Second Transition Attack
drills.description: Coach shoots, the defense rebounds and has five seconds to get a shot at the other end. If they take longer the possession dies. Ten trips.
drills.coachingPoints: Rim runner goes on the shot, not on the rebound. First pass ahead beats three dribbles.

drills.name: Numbers Advantage Waves
drills.description: Coach calls a number and that many defenders sprint back while five attack, so the advantage changes every rep. Continuous for four minutes.
drills.coachingPoints: Count the defenders as you cross half court. Attack the open side before they match up.

drills.name: Talk Every Possession
drills.description: Live four-on-four where the defense loses the possession outright if the coach does not hear the ball call, a screen call, and a shot call. Play eight possessions.
drills.coachingPoints: Ball, help, screen left, shot. Say it before it happens, not after.

drills.name: Two-Ball Rebound Positioning
drills.description: Coach shoots one ball while a second is rolled toward a corner. Player must secure the live rebound first, then chase the loose ball. Eight reps.
drills.coachingPoints: Finish the first job before you look for the second. Two hands on the board, always.

drills.name: Offensive Board Crash Rules
drills.description: Live five-on-five where two designated offensive players must crash the glass on every shot and the other three get back. Run ten possessions and count second-chance points.
drills.coachingPoints: Crashers go on the release. Everybody else is already retreating, no watching.
